evidence.title: Process baseline for the sulfuric-acid HEN case
evidence.relevant_excerpt: At delta_t_min = 10 C the known targets are heat recovery 490 kW, heating 100 kW, cooling 95 kW, hot/cold pinch 80/70 C.
evidence.claim_supported: The locked process has a validated baseline utility and recovery target at delta_t_min = 10 C.

evidence.title: Pinch Analysis: smaller delta_t_min can increase recovery potential
evidence.relevant_excerpt: In classical Pinch Analysis, reducing the minimum approach temperature (delta_t_min) generally increases the maximum theoretical process-to-process heat recovery and can reduce external utility targets, at the cost of larger exchanger area.
evidence.claim_supported: Lowering delta_t_min is a plausible lever for reducing external utility demand.

evidence.title: MVP controllable variable policy
evidence.relevant_excerpt: MVP experiments may vary only delta_t_min. Stream identities, Tin, Tout, FCp and h remain locked.
evidence.claim_supported: Computational experiments should change delta_t_min only in the MVP.

notes: Local approved evidence only. BrightData/web retrieval can be added later for the Evidence Agent alone.
